self_assessment: Implemented CADownloader/realDownloader/NewRealDownloader/downloadForCloudSQL in a new lib/srv/db/ca.go replacing aws.go, preserving RDS/Redshift behavior, using the repo's existing common.NewCloudClients()/sqladmin (v1beta4) GCP client to fetch Instances.Get(...).ServerCaCert.Cert with descriptive errors for missing cert/API failure, and wired an optional Config.CADownloader defaulting to NewRealDownloader(DataDir); build, go vet, and gofmt are clean, but the GCP API path (permission-denied wording, exact error semantics, and the local-file-naming scheme for the CA cache) is unverified against any real Cloud SQL instance or unit test since no CA-specific tests exist at this base commit and the whole lib/srv/db test suite fails to even run in this sandbox due to a pre-existing (base-commit-reproducible) Go 1.24/json-iterator runtime incompatibility unrelated to this change.
